chunks: Abu al-Hasan Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn al-Salt al-Ahwazi informed me, saying: Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Sa'id ibn 'Uqdah informed us, saying: Ahmad ibn 'Umar ibn Muhammad ibn al-Hasan narrated to me, saying: My father narrated to me, saying: Muhammad ibn 'Abd Allah ibn Khalid, the mawla of Banu al-Sayda', narrated to us.
That he prayed behind Ja'far ibn Muhammad عليه السلام over a جنازة, and he saw him raising his hands at every takbir.

key_terms.تَكْبِيرَةٍ: a declaration of 'Allahu akbar' within the prayer
key_terms.جِنَازَةٍ: funeral bier or deceased person over whom the funeral prayer is performed
key_terms.خَلْفَ: behind, meaning in congregation following the Imam
key_terms.مَوْلَى: client or affiliated freedman associated with a tribe
key_terms.يَرْفَعُ يَدَيْهِ: he raises his hands, referring to the gesture during takbir

ai.seo_question: Did Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq عليه السلام raise his hands at every takbir in the funeral prayer?
ai.summary: This hadith reports that Imam Ja'far ibn Muhammad عليه السلام raised his hands at every takbir in the funeral prayer. It serves as evidence in jurisprudential discussions concerning the manner of performing salat over the deceased.
